'''Thera Markon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Daughter of the bounty hunter [[Crysta Markon]] who coached the [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], she ran a direct-to customer shipping concern on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. In [[3637 BBY]] her business was being harassed by the [[Kanawyn Syndicate]], when her mother showed up to visit and decided to deal with them. However, Crysta got killed and Thera had to ask for her [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] friend for help. She met the Hunter and [[Mako (slicer)|Mako]] in the [[Blaster's Path]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and outlined her story and profiles of the Kanawyn leaders, on which she put the bounty. After [[Avax]], [[Chrone]] and [[Dastid]] were all dealt with, the bounty hunter returned and Thera gave her thanks for avenging her mother.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thera Markon appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class quest on Rishi.<ref name="SWTOR" /> She is voiced by [[Laura Bailey]].

Thera Markon makes a reappearance in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' expansion if Imperial players are playing Bounty Hunter or Imperial Agent class during '''Update 7.4: Chains in the Dark''', during which she is taken hostage during the [[Hidden Chain]]'s attack on Port Nowhere. After the Bounty Hunter player had defeated [[Cantis Bralor]], they can choose whether to recognize Thera or not. Subsequently overhearing the holocall from [[Jekiah Ordo]] mentioning that the Hidden Chain were targeting [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], she suggested the [[Alliance Commander]] seek out [[Gizmel Gam]] on [[Kessan's Landing]] for information. For the characters of other classes, the same role is performed by [[Cedral Gend]], [[Tema Folaris]] or [[Markan]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Chains in the Dark|[[Port Nowhere]]}}</ref>
